title: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
title_zh: CIVER：面向可靠代码评审的因果干预验证

paragraphs.en: 提出基于因果干预的代码评审框架，通过评审、扰动与验证模块区分真实缺陷与误报，正确识别77%真实缺陷。 Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integrates three modules: a review module assesses findings, an intervention module generates repair-oriented perturbations, and a verifier module scores review reliability. Through joint optimization via expert iteration, the three modules identify genuine defects by responding to targeted repairs while remaining stable under unrelated changes. Extensive experiments on SWE-Review-Bench demonstrate that CIVER correctly identifies 77% of genuine defects through targeted repairs. Cross-project and downstream repair evaluations further demonstrate that CIVER generalizes across repositories and improves coding agents' task success rates, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable automated code review.
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于因果干预的代码评审框架，通过评审、扰动与验证模块区分真实缺陷与误报，正确识别77%真实缺陷。代码评审通过识别缺陷、提升代码质量并支持可靠的软件演化，对维护软件仓库至关重要。 随着基于LLM的编码智能体的日益普及，越来越多的代码贡献和仓库变更由这些智能体生成。 因此，基于LLM的代码评审智能体正变得日益普遍，用于评估这些贡献并维护软件质量。 然而，LLM评审者常常生成包含大量潜在问题的冗长评审，其中许多是误报或缺乏充分证据。 这些不可靠的评审可能误导开发者和下游的编码智能体，因此需要区分可操作的发视与无依据的断言。 我们提出CIVER，这是一个基于因果干预的框架，能够识别代码评审发现背后的核心问题，并区分真实缺陷与误报。 CIVER集成了三个模块：评审模块评估发现，干预模块生成面向修复的扰动，验证模块对评审可靠性进行打分。 通过专家迭代的联合优化，这三个模块通过响应针对性修复来识别真实缺陷，同时在无关变更下保持稳定。 在SWE-Review-Bench上的大量实验表明，CIVER通过针对性修复正确识别了77%的真实缺陷。 跨项目和下游修复评估进一步表明，CIVER能够在不同仓库之间泛化并提升编码智能体的任务成功率，凸显了其在可靠自动化代码评审方面的有效性。
